findings.evidence: Multiple pageerror entries: 'AxiosError: Request failed with status code 429' uncaught at axios settle (vendor.js:10901). notes: 6 P0 findings. Three clusters dominate: (1) capture-spec navigation failures — kiosk wizard 404s (A-001, A-002), POS wizard captured at wrong step (A-003, A-004), kiosk before-state captured from drinks page not wizard (A-008). (2) rate-limit storm on availability/variation/toggle endpoint poisons both admin restore (A-005) and downstream POS bootstrap (A-006, A-013). (3) Cross-surface cascade only verifiable for S2 (burger->POS catalogue, A-017 shows it works) — S3/S4/S5/S6 cascades remain UNVERIFIED because the wizard captures never reached the right step or 404'd. Also caught: i18n leak (A-007), duplicate Suppléments rail entry (A-015), naming drift extras vs Autres (A-009), wrong state for variations (A-010), UI truncation (A-012, A-016), missing aria-live on error (A-011). Recommendation: GStack round 2 must fix capture spec navigation FIRST (cluster 1), then rate-limit storm SECOND (cluster 2). Without both fixed, no cross-surface cascade beyond S2 can be attested.
